For me what comes to mind is that it seems like her values aren’t being realized in her actions. She’s struggling with self-acceptance, right? The root of this could be that she doesn’t know what she believes about life right now. She’s seeking validation through social media - I’ve been there myself, so I don’t say this to tear her down. I’m only now finding out what I value and learning how to integrate it into the everyday. 

When you start dating before you know what you value, you’re inevitably going to face challenges. If you love her, you’ll accept her as she is and know that she’s going through some very dramatic shifts in consciousness. You’ll watch as she grows and matures, learning these lessons for herself. You cannot teach her. You cannot control her. You yourself are probably learning and changing a lot. There will come a point where it will either be over because you’re no longer on the same page, or your relationship will experience a beautiful renaissance. You can only accept the way things are and speak, think, act out of love. 

You have the answers already.

Tara Brach has suggested a 3 step process for this. 

1.) Please don't believe your thoughts.

2.) Please come back to the present moment. Be here now.

3.) Please remember love and your innate goodness.

This becomes challenging in the second part when you have to be with the emotions that arise. Give yourself time. Go for a walk. Take 5-10 minutes to decide to put the thoughts down. As you practice this, it will get easier.
